name: Aeontek Co., Ltd.
summary: Aeon Motor Co., Ltd. is primarily involved in the conceptualization, manufacturing, and distribution of a wide range of vehicles. This includes scooters, all-terrain vehicles (ATVs), utility task vehicles (UTVs), motorcycles, and electric vehicles, all marketed under its proprietary Aeon brand within Taiwan. In addition to these vehicles, the company offers various components and related merchandise. Aeon Motor also conducts extensive international export operations. The firm was established in 1998 and operates from its main office located in Tainan City, Taiwan.
